race.comment: AGATHA (9) win record hardly excites but comes her at the top of her game fourth up. Kept finding with the 59kg for a narrow third over 1100m at this track. Drops 4kg in a very thin BM78. Hard to hold out. SWORDPLAY (1) speedy mare resuming from a five-month break. Failed to come up last prep with a disappointing eighth over 1000m at Eagle Farm. Looks to be back on track after scoring two sound trial wins. Respect with the claim. SHOW BUSINESS (11) comes to hand quickly and caught the eye first up. Maps well and looks set for a big campaign. REGIMENTAL COLOURS (3) was better second-up at Warwick Farm and is open to further improvement. Can fill a spot in the minors.
